leadText:
Teacup Town (Japanese: チャバタウン Chaba Town) is an -exclusive location. The town is surrounded by tea fields and has been described as a place where the fragrant aroma of tea leaves permeates the air .

In Clash of the Nidothing Fans, Liko and Roy visited Teacup Town to meet with the witness Litten Smitten after the two received an eyewitness report about Black Rayquaza from Dot. Liko was then engaged in a battle against Litten Smitten after the latter found out the two are members of the Rising Volt Tacklers. The battle was interrupted by Ult, who was being chased by a group of and . After Liko and Roy used their Pokémon to calm down the wild Pokémon, Litten Smitten was convinced of their innocence and revealed that the eyewitness report she provided was false.
